llm.rationale: The workflow uses a large matrix of Ruby versions, Gemfiles, and databases, which results in many redundant dependency installations. Implementing `actions/cache@v4` for the Bundler cache (keyed by the specific Gemfile and Ruby version) can reduce the time spent in `bundle install` across the matrix. Although `ruby/setup-ruby` with `bundler-cache: true` already provides some caching, adding an explicit cache step or ensuring the existing mechanism is optimized for the matrix is the goal. Since `setup-ruby` is already present, I will add a dedicated `actions/cache` step to explicitly manage the Bundler path to ensure the distributed cache pattern is implemented as requested, even though `setup-ruby` is a high-level abstraction of this.
